claim: Randall argues the shifts (1) let the reader assimilate the secondary world, (2) build knowledge of character, (3) move the story from kernel to kernel, and (4) delay the unfolding of each plot-line, all serving a rhetoric of grandeur and scope.

verdict.trueWording: The effect ... is four-fold

Third effect is worded 'incident to incident' with kernels glossed in the same sentence; 'kernel to kernel' is Randall's own later phrase ('The shifts in focalization move the plot from kernel to kernel').

claim: Rettino notes the narrator adopts a cautious, guessing persona ('perhaps because...') whose judgments the naive reader must nonetheless accept, the club-story authority of portal-quest fantasy.
